rationale: Evidence from the tool calls indicates the agent executed order- and account-changing writes without first confirming with the user, which violates the stated policy. Specifically, the agent appears to have: (1) modified the shipping address on two orders (#W1603792 and #W1092119) rather than only the incorrect one, despite the user saying the luggage set already went to the new address; (2) changed the user’s default address; and (3) initiated an exchange on order #W1603792. These were all performed via modify_* and exchange_* calls with no prior confirmation step visible. Additionally, there’s no clear, robust authentication beyond looking up by email; and it’s unclear the agent verified and selected the cheapest tablet before exchanging. The user also asked not to reveal the address; while we can’t see the final message content, the agent hard-specified an address in the tool calls, suggesting possible non-compliance with the user’s preference. Given these issues, the request was not completed in line with policy.
